messages.content: Independent enterprise predeployment rubric for exact SHA 949249d9aa9604c3c3645b76600845e6f8178a83. P means PASS and F means FAIL. Mark F only for a concrete unresolved material defect demonstrated by the supplied evidence. An unchanged, already-tested control is not a defect. Deployment itself is the next signed step. Output schema JSON only.

Review the exact V7 release candidate using these facts only.
architecture: The change reuses the existing Next/Node/Graph architecture; product code changed only UI/UX components and CSS.
security_privacy: Authentication, tenant isolation, private API boundaries, and server upload authorization were not modified. Existing browser/API tests pass.
supply_chain: package.json, pnpm-lock, Docker/Compose and deploy code are unchanged; production audit has no known vulnerabilities.
agent_tool_governance: V7 adds NO agent, tool, provider call, approval authority, release authority, or mutation authority. CreationRoom is display-only and reads the already-authoritative job/Graph state. Provider/tool execution remains in the existing governed worker path. The UI explicitly states that its percent is verified Graph workflow progress, not provider render progress.
state_concurrency: repository/concurrency and transition code are unchanged.
evidence_release_integrity: exact commit is 949249d9aa9604c3c3645b76600845e6f8178a83; exact production-source hash is 56cdf249e66c67e2e6efca4131db89b84e84d2371e103eac4f80cff917f63d37. Full exact suite and detached verifier pass. Successful generic browser, FIRMES completion, and source-recovery journeys all report this same production-source hash.
fail_closed_behavior: CreationRoom is rendered only when the job is not reviewable, not released, has zero blockers, and status is RUNNING or QUEUED. BLOCKED, WAITING_EXTERNAL_GENERATION, human review gates and RELEASED continue to their existing specialized paths. Missing authorized media still blocks production. Source upload still validates tenant authorization, max bytes, allowed MIME and byte signature before storage. Review/release remain explicit authenticated hash-bound actions.
testing: 177 discovered / 176 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; focused V7 5/5; typecheck PASS; production build PASS; contracts 13/13; audit clean; detached verifier 56/56 + typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS; generic browser/FIRMES/source-recovery E2Es PASS against the exact production-source hash.
operations_recovery: deployment code is unchanged; current public baseline is converged with public health and process recovery PASS. Signed deployment is the next step.
portability: React/TypeScript/CSS only; native file input remains accessible; desktop/mobile responsive checks pass; reduced-motion rules are present.
The persistent workstation later encountered runtime PID pressure during redundant browser retries; those attempts are preserved as environment evidence and do not report a product assertion defect.
